output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 11,250 to 6,818 characters (39.4%) and from 153 to 74 lines. It retains component boundaries, dependencies, ownership and publication contracts. Six peripherals give implementation details a primary home: checkpoint reconstruction, delivery/retries, candidate validation, catalog publication, read scope and backing storage. Numeric limits, retry branches and cleanup sequences are outside the central overview. [M] means modular structure, [C] source-described call flow, [O] ownership and [D] data dependency; these are not execution traces.

This addresses the storage-specific critique while preserving precise attachments and evidence limits. Peripherals sit beside their relevant central branches, with at least 20 empty columns between text rectangles and seven empty rows between vertically adjacent peripherals. All 12 edge endpoints, ASCII constraints, connectivity and rectangle bounds were checked. The complete result has 173 lines. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Corrections established by the pinned source: CanvasValueEncoder is exported; its internal state is private. WorkspacePersistence exposes setPaused, not pause. capture hydrates the selected head and exact bound revisions but pins ALL document checkpoint/revision/item references. Only loadCanvasCheckpoint bypasses ancestor replay with a supplied head map; restoreCanvasCheckpoints replays and compares that map. The catalog source-binding caller supplies every stored catalog revision, not just current published revisions. Catalog serialization applies to wrapped operations; public saveRepresentationCatalog does not itself enter the queue. The seed's UI-installation-after-acknowledgement claim is a source comment describing a caller contract, not demonstrated caller behavior, so the diagrams describe acknowledgement without asserting that UI behavior.

Peripheral evidence: codec uses canvasCheckpointRecords.ts; retry uses recordStorage.ts and workspaceRecordStore.ts; checks uses workspaceRecords.ts and workspaceRecordStore.ts; publish uses canvasCatalogStore.ts and workspaceRecordStore.ts; reads uses diagramPersistence.ts and canvasCatalogStore.ts; blobs uses workspaceRecordStore.ts, diagramRevisionStore.ts and immutableRecords.ts. The browser overview also uses workspacePersistence.ts. Added details include interrupted-view normalization, reverse diff application, the first background retry at 1000 ms, explicit commit's retry of conflicts, acceptance receipt comparison fields and source-binding cache invalidation.

Workspace publication explicitly syncs files and directories; DiagramRevisionStore has no explicit fsync. Catalog comments state atomic replacement, but the imported writeJsonAtomic implementation is not pinned, so its crash durability cannot be verified. Imported validators and publication rules are represented only at their supplied call boundaries. No cross-process locking or garbage collection is inferred.

The critique and previous output were review material, not code evidence. The collection-wide suggestion to reconcile other points cannot establish additional behavior from these inputs; those unsupported extensions are not adopted. Textual navigation names only the related point IDs canvas and diagrams supplied by context.json. No other point is recreated, and no unavailable destination diagram or external edge is invented.

diagrams.ascii:
Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence
|-- [M] Checkpoint codec: expanded canvas state <-> immutable records
|   |-- Exposes CanvasCheckpointEncoder, CanvasValueEncoder and snapshot restoration functions
|   |-- [D] Snapshot payload -> path-keyed value records -> shared text items addressed by hash
|   |   `-- Parent skeletons preserve ordering; decoding returns document, view and revision bindings
|   |-- Related point canvas: this storage boundary serializes checkpoint graphs and exact bindings
|   |-- Checkpoint identity and logical history parent remain distinct from the delta replay base
|   |   `-- Reference-map differences encode changes; periodic full maps bound ancestor replay
|   |-- Selected-head loading can use its supplied map; full restoration checks that map by replay
|   `-- [O] Encoders retain known content and checkpoint maps; incremental output drains new items
|
|-- [M] Browser persistence: live session changes -> workspace record batches
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence exposes sync/update/setPaused/dispose; owns subscriptions and cursors
|   |   `-- Session persistenceChanges(cursor) and source-pane captures supply the save projection
|   |-- [D] Workspace index identifies documents, active canvas and transfers between canvases
|   |   |-- Document records separate metadata/baseline, checkpoint history and current presentation
|   |   `-- View records share immutable items with history; viewport remains independently stored
|   |-- [C] Notifications project changed records -> deduplicate keys/items -> RecordStorage.batch
|   |   `-- Removed documents and replaced history graphs delete obsolete keys in the same batch
|   |-- RecordStorage exposes local reads, batch, flush, commit and status; transport is injected
|   |   `-- write({requestId, expectedRevision, changes}) returns the accepted workspace revision
|   |-- [O] Storage owns local cache, pending edits and one retained flight awaiting acknowledgement
|   |   `-- New edits can accumulate while an identical failed flight is preserved for retransmission
|   |-- Autosave advances its accepted revision only on success; definitive conflicts stop scheduling
|   |-- Explicit commit first flushes earlier work, then awaits its transaction's acknowledgement
|   |   `-- Rejection rolls back the transaction cache; ambiguous errors retain the request for retry
|   `-- Bridge disposal unsubscribes; storage disposal stops scheduling; orderly close requires flush
|
|-- [M] WorkspaceRecordStore: candidate records -> one published workspace manifest
|   |-- Exposes state/load/apply/replace/capture/viewHeaders; validation and codec are dependencies
|   |-- [O] Private manifest owns record-key reachability, workspace revision and request receipts
|   |   `-- Immutable blobs hold content; removing a manifest key does not delete the backing blob
|   |-- [C] apply serializes through a process-local queue shared by stores with the same root
|   |   |-- Receipt check precedes revision check, allowing an accepted request to recover its result
|   |   `-- New requests must match expectedRevision before a candidate record set is constructed
|   |-- Candidate acceptance preserves immutable revisions/items and semantic checkpoint contents
|   |   `-- validateRecordUpdate checks affected histories, current presentation and transfer links
|   |-- [C] Publication writes backing blobs before replacing the manifest with references + receipt
|   |   `-- This is the workspace batch commit boundary; ambiguous failure requires the same retry ID
|   |-- [D] capture pins one manifest and requires the requested current checkpoint and canvas version
|   |   `-- Hydrates that head and bound revisions, while retaining all document record references
|   `-- viewHeaders exposes saved-view metadata without loading checkpoint bodies or diagram revisions
|
|-- [M] CanvasCatalogStore: persisted histories -> published canvas heads and receipts
|   |-- Exposes publication, multi-canvas acceptance, catalog reads and archive operations
|   |   `-- Composes catalog rules, a history service and DiagramPersistence behind these operations
|   |-- [C] publishCheckpoint checks receipt identity and expected target revision before capture
|   |   |-- Capture supplies persisted head/revisions; publication rules check the candidate canvas
|   |   `-- New catalog content points to captured workspace records; old revisions stay encoded
|   |-- acceptCanvasChanges checks distinct documents/targets and each expected published revision
|   |   |-- New target forks proposed history; existing target adopts it into the saved history
|   |   `-- Candidate heads and before/after acceptance receipts are saved in one catalog replacement
|   |-- Output promotion saves group membership, canvases and receipt together; archive changes metadata
|   |-- [O] Catalog owns published references; backing stores retain the content those references need
|   |   `-- Workspace autosave and catalog publication are separate commits, with separate receipts
|   `-- Wrapped operations serialize per instance; catalog replacement delegates to writeJsonAtomic
|
`-- [M] DiagramPersistence: portable documents <-> references to stored immutable content
    |-- Exposes persist/restore/currentHistory/sourceBindings over DiagramRecordStore.put/get
    |   `-- Record kinds are diagram/revision/history/workspace; public documents remain expanded
    |-- Related point diagrams: validated immutable revisions cross this persistence/restore boundary
    |-- [C] persist validates history and writes diagrams, dependent revisions and checkpoint items
    |   `-- Returns encoded history with checkpoint maps and an archive reference before catalog save
    |-- [D] Current published canvas: catalog revision -> history head -> exact bound diagram revisions
    |   |-- currentHistory normally returns a validated one-head history and registers its revisions
    |   `-- Saved or recording views require restoring the wider graph their archived checkpoints need
    |-- Full restore resolves references, reconstructs checkpoints and validates/registers revisions
    |   `-- Repeated record reads are coalesced; hydrated reference results are cloned for consumers
    |-- sourceBindings extracts head-bound diagram metadata for every history supplied by its caller
    |   `-- The catalog caller supplies every stored catalog revision, including non-current revisions
    |-- [M] DiagramRevisionStore implements hashed record IO; workspace references reuse workspace blobs
    |   `-- Workspace publication and this adapter have different durability implementations
    `-- [O] Independent ImmutableRecords utility retains a bounded cache of immutable JSON blobs
        `-- Its publishJson helper is not called by the pinned workspace or catalog store code

Checkpoint representation and reconstruction
|-- [D] Split scene children, edges, bindings and selected view collections
|   |-- Root key "[]"; parent skeletons preserve null placeholders and ordering
|   `-- sourceAscii or strings >= 512 characters become shared canvas-text items
|-- [O] CanvasValueEncoder hashes serialized items; equal content reuses identity
|   `-- takeItems() drains pending items; takeItems(true) returns all known items
|-- [C] Encode a delta only when the known parent has depth < 31
|   `-- Otherwise emit a full map at depth 0; keep parentId, omit baseId
|-- [C] Apply reference differences with checked old values
|   |-- Added keys must be absent; updated/removed keys must match their old hash
|   `-- Reject duplicate keys/invalid hashes; reverse swaps additions and removals
|-- [C] loadCanvasCheckpoint with head map skips ancestor replay
|   |-- Check requested head ID and map shape; verify fetched value/text hashes
|   `-- Without a head map, replay checks cycles, depth and baseId == parentId
|-- [C] restoreCanvasCheckpoints instead replays and compares the supplied map
|   `-- Optional reuse requires identical checkpoint/dependency objects and equal refs
`-- [C] readCanvasRecords fills text placeholders, then record paths by depth
    `-- Reject missing root/parents, malformed paths and non-null placeholders

Delivery: local edits, frozen requests and acknowledgement
|-- [C] batch compares values deeply and coalesces the last change per key
|   `-- Default autosave delay: 150 ms, capped by 1 s of pending age
|-- [O] pump retains requestId, expectedRevision, changes and sequence as one flight
|   |-- Clear pending for newer edits; concurrent pump callers share one promise
|   `-- Success clears flight and advances persisted sequence; failure keeps it
|-- [C] Background failure increments the count before calculating retry delay
|   |-- First retry: 1000 ms; subsequent delays double, capped at 30000 ms
|   `-- REJECTED:, VERSION_CONFLICT and REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT stop scheduling
|-- [C] commit's initial flush is outside its retry loop
|   |-- Initial failure exits before submitting the transaction
|   |-- Then snapshot cache -> batch changes -> flush until acknowledged
|   |-- REJECTED: restore cache; clear pending/flight; throw
|   `-- Other failures, including conflicts: retry after 500 ms until success/disposal
`-- [D] Server receipt check binds requestId to the hash of the entire input batch
    |-- Same ID/hash returns the recorded revision before expectedRevision is checked
    `-- Different hash conflicts; no receipt + stale revision also conflicts

Save projection and candidate acceptance
|-- [C] canvasViewChanges normalizes a clone before encoding canvas-view-v1
|   |-- Pending conversation with context gains an interruption error
|   |-- Remove conversation progress; clear pending
|   `-- Generating surfaces become errors requiring review before retry
|-- [C] validateRecordUpdate checks record namespace and references
|   |-- Project matches; <= 100 unique document IDs; active document must exist
|   |-- Canonically encoded IDs and supported suffixes; no removed-document records
|   |-- Changed items must hash to their keys; each document needs core records
|   `-- Affected histories and current presentations are validated separately
|       `-- History removals trigger full validation on the normal update path
|-- [C] WorkspaceRecordStore.apply checks existing checkpoint changes via stateKey
|   `-- Re-encoding may change bytes; transactionId is excluded from comparison
`-- [D] Transfer validation binds two distinct existing participants
    |-- Both need before/after checkpoints; transfer IDs must be unique
    `-- Destination after-checkpoint links transactionId; moves also link the source

Catalog publication: capture and receipt identities
|-- [D] capture reads one manifest; headId and metadata.version must match
|   |-- Hydrate selected checkpoint and exact bound revisions; verify blob hashes
|   `-- Pin ALL document checkpoints/revisions/items as workspace blob references
|-- [C] publishCheckpoint compares JSON.stringify(parsed input) with its receipt
|   |-- Same requestId/signature returns before capture; changed signature conflicts
|   |-- Existing target must be settled; expected revision and ownership must match
|   `-- Rules use a one-head history; published content is replaced by capture.stored
|-- [C] Acceptance receipt lookup uses changeSessionId
|   |-- Compare requestId and sessionVersion; full document payload is not compared
|   `-- Persist candidate catalog backing records before writing heads + receipt
|-- [C] Promotion placement lineage can be supplied once after publication
|   `-- Match request/signature; reject changes to existing lineage
`-- [O] Catalog replacement is separate from workspace manifest replacement
    |-- saveRepresentationCatalog persists first, then calls writeJsonAtomic
    |-- That public save method does not itself enter the per-instance queue
    `-- Atomic visibility is stated in comments; helper body/durability are unpinned

Read scope follows the requested result
|-- [D] storedHead selects workspace references, format-2 archive or legacy bindings
|   `-- Expanded history uses its snapshot directly
|-- [C] currentHistory normally creates a one-head history
|   |-- baselineId = headId; clear past/future; omit head parentId
|   `-- Missing revision parents become revisionBoundary entries
|-- [C] Saved/recording views select full graph restore with current validation
|   `-- Registry.restore is used for current validation; register for all validation
|-- [C] Full restore coalesces reads/hydration by kind + hash
|   `-- Captured evidence stays opaque; hydrated references return cloned values
|-- [D] Catalog source metadata scans EVERY stored revision's history head
|   |-- diagramBindings -> revision -> diagram.sourceContext.binding
|   `-- Validate bindings; deduplicate serialized values in last-occurrence order
`-- [O] Catalog source-binding cache holds one promise keyed by file metadata
    |-- Key: project/path/inode/size/mtime/ctime; preferred path falls back to legacy
    `-- Failed promise clears entry; successful callers receive clones

Backing storage: durability and retained objects
|-- [C] Workspace publication uses at most 8 blob writers
|   |-- Existing bytes must match; new temp file -> write -> fsync -> close -> rename
|   |-- Await every writer, including failures; sync blob directory before manifest
|   `-- Manifest: file sync -> rename -> directory sync; finally remove temp files
|-- [O] Workspace cache reuses parsed records when raw manifest text matches
|   `-- Project is checked; a later all-history read upgrades current-only validation
|-- [M] DiagramRevisionStore verifies existing bytes and hashes on reads
|   `-- New records use writeFile + rename + cleanup; no explicit fsync is present
|-- [O] Independent ImmutableRecords cache: <= 256 entries and <= 32 MiB
|   |-- Oversized items bypass cache; evict oldest insertion, not least-recent read
|   `-- get returns the cached object directly; internal callers must keep it immutable
|-- [C] Independent publishJson syncs file and directory around rename
|   `-- Pinned workspace/catalog stores do not call this helper or ImmutableRecords
`-- [O] Failed publication can leave unreachable blobs; no garbage collection is shown
